question: The conversion of ethanol to ethanoic acid is an example of which of the following reactions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxidation reaction**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The conversion of ethanol to ethanoic acid is an example of an **oxidation reaction**.
 
• In this reaction, ethanol (C₂H₅OH) is oxidized to form ethanoic acid (CH₃COOH).
